models.name: ecommerce_mall_guests

models.name: ecommerce_mall_guest_sessions

Sessions track navigation context (IP, href, referrer) for anonymous browsing continuity. Sessions expire after configurable duration and are invalidated on logout or expiration.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_customers
models.description:
Registered customer accounts with email and password credentials for authenticated shopping on the platform. Each customer has a unique email address that serves as the login identifier and cannot be changed after registration. Customers can soft-delete their accounts, which preserves order history and reviews for legal and seller records while removing profile information. The soft delete is implemented via the deleted_at field - when set, the account is considered inactive but data remains for historical reference.

This table represents the core customer identity in the system. Upon successful registration (section 45), a new customer record is created along with an empty wishlist and empty shopping cart. The email address is case-sensitive during comparison while passwords are not case-sensitive (section 49).

Related entities managed through separate tables: customer_sessions for login tracking, customer_profiles for display name and phone, customer_password_resets for recovery, customer_email_verifications for registration confirmation, shipping_addresses for delivery locations, carts and cart_items for shopping, wishlists and wishlist_items for bookmarks, orders for transactions, reviews for product feedback, cancellation_requests and refund_requests for disputes.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address serving as the login identifier for the customer account. Case-sensitive during comparison. Cannot be changed after registration.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for authentication. Password comparison is not case-sensitive.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the account is inactive but order history and reviews are preserved for seller records and legal compliance. Null means the account is active.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for customer authentication with access and refresh token support. Tracks login sessions with IP address, page navigation, and referrer information for security auditing. Each session belongs to one customer and has an expiration time for automatic session invalidation.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who owns this session. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token string for authenticated API requests.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token string for obtaining new access tokens.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client device at session creation.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current page URL or endpoint being accessed.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header indicating the previous page.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was last updated.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and becomes invalid.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for customer account recovery. Stores temporary tokens with expiration timestamps that allow customers to reset their passwords. Each token belongs to one customer and can only be used once. Tokens expire after a set duration and are never soft deleted since they are short-lived.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who requested the password reset. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token string for security validation.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp after which the token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was used to reset password. Null if unused.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for customer registration confirmation. Each token is generated during customer sign-up and must be verified to activate the account. Tokens expire after a set period and are single-use - verification marks them as completed. Managed through registration flow, not direct user CRUD operations.

Tokens are created when customers register and deleted or marked invalid after successful verification or expiration.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer who initiated email verification. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token string generated for email confirmation. Must be cryptographically random and unique.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for the verification token. After this time, the token becomes invalid and cannot be used.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when email verification was completed. Null indicates token is still pending verification.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sellers
models.description: Registered seller accounts with email/password authentication and approval workflow for product selling. Sellers must be approved by administrators before they can list products. Tracks approval status (pending/approved/rejected), rejection reasons, and supports soft deletion with conditional rules based on pending orders and requests.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for seller login and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for secure authentication.

plainFields.name: approval_status
plainFields.description: Current approval status of the seller registration. Values: pending, approved, rejected.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for rejection provided by administrators when approval_status is rejected.

plainFields.name: rejected_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller registration was rejected.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null if active, populated if deleted. Deletion only allowed if no pending orders or requests.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for seller authentication with access and refresh token support. Each login creates a session record tracking client metadata (IP, browser info) and JWT token lifecycle. Sessions are invalidated on logout or expiration. Belongs to {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id} for authentication verification.

foreignFields.description: Belonged seller's {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}. Establishes session ownership to a specific seller account for authentication verification.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from the request for security tracking and audit purposes.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URL path for session activity tracking and security monitoring.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header value indicating the previous page URL for session origin tracking.

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token string for authenticated API requests. Null when session uses only refresh token.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token string for obtaining new access tokens. Null when session is expired or invalidated.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp recording when the seller logged in.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. After this time, the session and its tokens become invalid for authentication.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for seller account recovery. Stores secure reset tokens with expiration timestamps. Sellers request password resets, receive token via email, and use token to set new password. Each token can only be used once (used_at tracks usage). Expired or used tokens are rejected during password reset flow.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_id

plainFields.name: token

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for the reset token. Token becomes invalid after this time.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token was used to change password. Null indicates unused token.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset was requested.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for seller registration confirmation. Stores temporary verification tokens sent to seller email addresses during registration. Tokens are single-use and expire after a set duration. Links to {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id} for verification confirmation.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller being verified. {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token string sent to the seller's email address.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address being verified for the seller account.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for the verification token. After this time, the token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the email was successfully verified. Null if not yet verified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification record was last updated.

models.description: Administrator accounts with email/password authentication for elevated platform management privileges. Administrators can manage seller approvals, product oversight, order management, and user account administration. models.name: ecommerce_mall_admin_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for administrator account recovery. Stores secure one-time tokens with expiration timestamps. models.name: ecommerce_mall_admin_audit_logs
models.description: Immutable audit trail recording all administrative actions performed on the platform. Tracks which admin performed what action on which resource, when, and from where. Essential for security accountability, compliance auditing, and investigating suspicious activities. This table is append-only - audit records cannot be modified or deleted.

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: ecommerce_mall_super_admin_audit_logs
models.description: Immutable audit trail records capturing all super administrator actions for platform accountability and security review. Each record tracks who performed what action, on which target, when, and from where. Super administrators can promote or demote other administrators, manage platform settings, and perform other privileged operations - all of which are logged here. Audit logs cannot be deleted to ensure compliance and enable security investigations.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_super_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the super administrator who performed the action. {@link ecommerce_mall_super_admins.id}

plainFields.name: user_agent

models.name: ecommerce_mall_admin_requests
models.description: Administrator role requests submitted by users (customers or sellers) to gain administrative privileges on the platform. Supports polymorphic ownership where requests can originate from either customers or sellers. Super administrators review and approve or reject these requests with optional rejection reasons. The request tracks the requested privilege grade and complete review workflow status.

foreignFields.name: reviewed_by_id

plainFields.description: Optional reason provided by super administrator when rejecting the request.

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: ecommerce_mall_admin_request_of_customers
models.description: Links admin requests to the customer who submitted them. Implements the subtype pattern for polymorphic ownership where admin requests can belong to either customers or sellers. Each customer can have only one admin request at a time, enforced by unique constraint on customer_id. This table ensures referential integrity and enables direct querying of customer-admin request relationships.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_admin_request_id
foreignFields.description: Linked admin request. {@link ecommerce_mall_admin_requests.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who submitted this admin request. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the link was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the link was last updated.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_admin_request_of_sellers
models.description:
Links admin requests to the seller who submitted them. Each seller can have only one admin request at a time. This table implements the subtype pattern for polymorphic ownership where admin requests can be submitted by either customers or sellers.

The unique constraint on seller_id ensures business rule enforcement: each seller may only have one pending or historical admin request. References {@link ecommerce_mall_admin_requests.id} and {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_admin_request_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the admin request this seller submission belongs to. {@link ecommerce_mall_admin_requests.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller who submitted this admin request. {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this link was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this link was last updated.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_super_admin_audit_log_metadata

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_profiles

Public shop profiles containing shop name, business description, and logo image for sellers. One profile per seller, editable with automatic snapshot creation on changes.

Each seller has exactly one shop profile that customers can view when browsing products or visiting seller pages. The profile stores the public-facing shop information including the shop name displayed in product listings, a business description explaining the shop's background and offerings, and a logo image for brand identification. All profile edits are automatically captured as immutable snapshots in {@link ecommerce_mall_seller_profile_snapshots} for historical tracking and dispute resolution. Profiles support soft deletion for account cleanup while preserving audit trails.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Business description of the shop explaining its background, specialties, and offerings. Visible to customers on seller profile pages.

plainFields.name: logo_uri

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_profile_snapshots

Preserves shop name, description, and logo state for historical reference and dispute resolution. Each snapshot is created automatically when orders are placed or when sellers edit their shop profile, providing an audit trail of how shop information appeared at specific moments in time.

plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null if not deleted.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_categories
models.description: Product category taxonomy with hierarchical structure supporting one level of parent-child nesting. Categories are created and managed by administrators only. Each category can have an optional parent category to create subcategories (one level deep). Products belonging to deleted categories become uncategorized. Soft delete preserves category data while hiding from listings.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to parent category for hierarchical taxonomy. Null for top-level categories. {@link ecommerce_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category name displayed to users. Must be unique within the same parent scope.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional category description providing additional context about the category.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null when active, set when deleted. Deleted categories are hidden but products remain with null category reference.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_products
models.description:
Main product listings owned by sellers with category assignment, base price, and soft delete support.

Each product represents a sale item created by a seller. Products belong to exactly one category and have a base price that serves as the default price for variants. Sellers can edit products, which creates immutable snapshots in the ProductSnapshot table for audit trail and dispute resolution.

Products are soft-deleted (hidden from search/listings) when sellers delete them, but order history preserves the product information through snapshots. Products without any variants are visible in search but shown as unavailable.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Owning seller's {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned category's {@link ecommerce_mall_categories.id}. Products become uncategorized when category is deleted.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name displayed in listings and search results.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed product description shown on product detail page.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Default price used when variants do not override pricing.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null when active, set when seller deletes product.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_product_images
models.description: Product image gallery supporting multiple images per product with display order for carousel/thumbnail functionality. Images are reorderable by sellers and automatically included in product snapshots to preserve historical product state.

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: Associated product's {@link ecommerce_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: URL of the product image file stored in file storage.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Sort order index for image display in product gallery. Lower values appear first. First image (order=0) is used as main thumbnail.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was added to the product.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was last updated or reordered.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variants
models.description: Product variants (SKUs) representing specific option combinations for products. Each variant has a unique SKU code, optional price override from base price, and current stock quantity. Variants belong to exactly one product and are the purchasable units in orders. Stock is tracked via inventory records, and all edits create immutable snapshots for audit purposes.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product's {@link ecommerce_mall_products.id}. Each variant must belong to exactly one product.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) code identifying this variant across the platform. Used in order items for display and inventory tracking. Must be unique globally.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Optional price override for this variant. When null, the product's base price applies. Allows variants with different prices (e.g., larger size costs more).

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Current available stock quantity for this variant. Represents the calculated stock from all inventory records. Starts at 0 when variant is created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the variant was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the variant was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null when active, set when seller deletes the variant.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_product_snapshots
models.description: Immutable point-in-time snapshots of product state captured during product edits and order placements. Each snapshot preserves the complete product data including name, description, base price, category name, and references to seller. Snapshots are created automatically whenever a seller edits their product and serve as authoritative historical records for dispute resolution. Once created, snapshots cannot be modified or deleted.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product being snapshotted. {@link ecommerce_mall_products.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller who owns this product snapshot. {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name as it appeared at the time of snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Product description as it appeared at the time of snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base price of the product as it appeared at the time of snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: category_name
plainFields.description: Category name the product belonged to at the time of snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variant_option_values
models.description: Normalized table storing individual option key-value pairs for product variants. Each row represents one option (e.g., color=Red, size=Large). This table replaces the JSON option_values field from the parent product_variants table to comply with First Normal Form (1NF) requirements. Every product variant can have multiple options, and each option key must be unique per variant.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product variant's {@link ecommerce_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Option key name such as 'color', 'size', or any attribute identifier.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Option value such as 'Red', 'Large', or corresponding attribute value.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this option was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this option was last updated.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_product_snapshot_images
models.description: Individual product snapshot image records storing URL and display order for each image in a product snapshot. Decomposed from JSON array to comply with 1NF. Each image belongs to exactly one product snapshot and cannot exist independently.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product snapshot's {@link ecommerce_mall_product_snapshots.id}.

plainFields.name: url
plainFields.description: URL of the image in the product snapshot.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Display order of the image for sorting. Lower values appear first.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image record was last updated.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_product_snapshot_variants
models.description:
Individual product snapshot variant records storing SKU, option key-value pairs, price override, and stock quantity for each variant in a product snapshot. Decomposed from JSON array to comply with 1NF.

This table captures the immutable state of a product variant at the time a product snapshot is created. Each record represents one variant option (e.g., color=red, size=large) with its SKU code, price override, and stock quantity at snapshot time. Option key-value pairs are stored in the related ecommerce_mall_product_snapshot_variant_option_values table.

This table is always accessed through its parent product_snapshot and cannot exist independently.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product snapshot that captured this variant state. {@link ecommerce_mall_product_snapshots.id}.

plainFields.name: sku
plainFields.description: Unique SKU code of the product variant at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: price_override
plainFields.description: Variant-specific price override. Null if using product base price.

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Stock quantity of the variant at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant snapshot was created.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_product_snapshot_variant_option_values
models.description: Individual option key-value pairs for product snapshot variants. Each row stores one option attribute (e.g., color=Red, size=Large). Decomposed from JSON array to comply with 1NF normalization. Part of the product snapshot system that preserves variant option state at purchase/edit time for dispute resolution.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_snapshot_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product snapshot variant's {@link ecommerce_mall_product_snapshot_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Option name identifying the attribute type such as color, size, or style.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Option value for the specified attribute such as Red, Large, or Cotton.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this option value was captured in the snapshot.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_inventory_records
models.description: Immutable inventory records tracking all stock changes for product variants including restocking, order deductions, adjustments, cancellations, and refunds. Each record captures quantity change (positive for restocking, negative for consumption), the business reason, and timestamp. Current stock is derived from sum of all records for a variant. Records are never updated or deleted to maintain complete audit trail.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: The product variant this inventory record applies to. {@link ecommerce_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity_change
plainFields.description: Stock quantity change value. Positive values indicate restocking or refunds, negative values indicate order deductions, cancellations, or adjustments.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Business reason for the inventory change such as 'restock', 'order_placement', 'order_cancellation', 'refund', or 'adjustment'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory change occurred.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_carts
models.description: Shopping carts belonging to customers. Each customer has exactly one cart enforced by unique constraint on customer_id. Cart items are stored separately in ecommerce_mall_cart_items table. Carts are created when a customer adds their first item and are cleared upon successful checkout.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Owner customer who owns this shopping cart. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was last modified.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_cart_items
models.description: Individual line items within a customer's shopping cart, each representing a specific product variant and quantity. The same variant can only appear once per cart - adding the same variant again increases quantity instead of creating a new line item. Price is derived from the referenced variant at display or checkout time.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: The shopping cart this item belongs to. {@link ecommerce_mall_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: The specific product variant added to cart. {@link ecommerce_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of this variant in the cart. When user adds same variant again, quantity increases instead of creating new line item.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the item was added to the cart.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the item quantity was last modified.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_wishlists
models.description: Customer wishlist entity representing the collection of product bookmarks for each customer. Each customer has exactly one wishlist created at registration time. The wishlist serves as a container for wishlist items that link customers to products they want to save for later purchase. {@link ecommerce_mall_wishlist_items} stores individual product links while this table represents the customer's wishlist collection.

foreignFields.name: shopping_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Owner customer who owns this wishlist. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was last modified.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_wishlist_items
models.description: Individual wishlist items linking customers to products they want to save for future purchase. Each item represents a product bookmark within a customer's wishlist. Products can only appear once per wishlist, enforced by unique constraint. Items are automatically removed when the linked product is deleted by the seller.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_wishlist_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent wishlist this item belongs to. {@link ecommerce_mall_wishlists.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product this item bookmarks. {@link ecommerce_mall_products.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the item was added to the wishlist.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_orders
models.description:
Main order records capturing completed purchase transactions with unique order numbers, customer reference, shipping address, and computed totals.

This table stores the primary order entity representing customer purchases. Each order belongs to exactly one customer and references a specific shipping address for delivery. Orders contain multiple order items capturing the purchased products at their prices at time of purchase.

Order status is derived from item statuses: 'paid' (all items paid), 'shipped' (any item shipped), 'delivered' (all items delivered), 'cancelled' (all items cancelled), 'refunded' (all items refunded), or 'partially_completed' (mixed states).

Relationships:
- Belongs to {@link ecommerce_mall_customers} via customer_id
- References {@link ecommerce_mall_shipping_addresses} for delivery destination
- Has many {@link ecommerce_mall_order_items} representing purchased products
- Order items reference {@link ecommerce_mall_product_snapshots} and {@link ecommerce_mall_seller_profile_snapshots} for historical data

Soft delete via deleted_at preserves order history for legal compliance and seller records.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who placed this order. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_shipping_address_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the shipping address for this order. {@link ecommerce_mall_shipping_addresses.id}. Locked at order placement time.

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Unique order number for customer reference. Generated at order creation time.

plainFields.name: subtotal
plainFields.description: Sum of all order item prices before shipping costs. Calculated at checkout.

plainFields.name: shipping_cost
plainFields.description: Total shipping fee for this order. Zero if free shipping applies.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Final order total including subtotal and shipping. subtotal + shipping_cost.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Computed order status derived from order items: 'paid', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled', 'refunded', or 'partially_completed'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was created (payment completed).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null when active, set when order is cancelled or archived.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_order_items
models.description: Individual line items within an order capturing purchased product variant at transaction time. Each order item preserves the product state (name, description, variant options, price) via product snapshots and seller profile state via seller profile snapshots. Item-level status enables partial order handling where individual items can be cancelled, refunded, or shipped independently while maintaining order integrity. The quantity and unit price are frozen at purchase time for dispute resolution.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Parent order this item belongs to. {@link ecommerce_mall_orders.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product purchased in this order item. {@link ecommerce_mall_products.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Specific product variant (SKU) purchased. {@link ecommerce_mall_product_variants.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Frozen product state at purchase time for dispute resolution. {@link ecommerce_mall_product_snapshots.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_profile_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Frozen seller profile state at purchase time for dispute resolution. {@link ecommerce_mall_seller_profile_snapshots.id}

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of the product variant purchased.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Unit price of the product variant at the time of purchase. Frozen at transaction time.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of this order item. Valid values: paid (payment completed, waiting to ship), shipped (item has been shipped), delivered (item delivered to customer), cancelled (item cancelled by seller), refunded (item refunded to customer).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item was last updated.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_shipments
models.description: Seller-bundled shipments containing one or more order items from the same seller, with tracking information for delivery tracking. Each shipment is created by a seller for their order items within a single order. Sellers can ship items individually or bundle multiple items together. Tracking information includes carrier name and tracking number for customer delivery tracking.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent order this shipment belongs to. {@link ecommerce_mall_orders.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller who created and owns this shipment. {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: carrier
plainFields.description: Name of the shipping carrier (e.g., DHL, FedEx, UPS, USPS).

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Tracking number provided by the carrier for shipment tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null when not deleted.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_shipment_items
models.description: Junction table establishing the many-to-many relationship between shipments and order items. Each shipment bundles one or more order items from the same seller, and each order item can belong to at most one shipment once shipped. This table enforces referential integrity and enables querying which items are included in each shipment package.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_shipment_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the shipment this item belongs to. {@link ecommerce_mall_shipments.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the order item included in this shipment. {@link ecommerce_mall_order_items.id}. Each order item can only belong to one shipment.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order item was added to the shipment.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_cancellation_requests
models.description: Customer-initiated requests to cancel order items with 'paid' status. Contains reason text for cancellation and seller approval workflow. When seller approves, item is cancelled and refund processed. Immutable audit trail preserved via snapshots.

foreignFields.description: Order item being requested for cancellation. {@link ecommerce_mall_order_items.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who initiated the cancellation request. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_id

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: ecommerce_mall_refund_requests
models.description: Customer-initiated refund requests for delivered order items within 7 days of delivery, containing reason text and seller approval workflow. Each request belongs to an order item, the requesting customer, and the seller. Sellers can approve or reject requests with responses captured in snapshots for audit trail.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: The order item being requested for refund. {@link ecommerce_mall_order_items.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who initiated the refund request. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: ecommerce_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable snapshots of cancellation request state captured when seller approves or rejects, preserving reason and status for audit and dispute resolution.

Each snapshot is created automatically when a seller responds to a cancellation request, capturing the reason text and response status at that moment. These records are immutable and cannot be modified or deleted, serving as permanent audit trail for order dispute resolution.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_cancellation_request_id
foreignFields.description: The cancellation request this snapshot preserves. {@link ecommerce_mall_cancellation_requests.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason text from the original cancellation request captured at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status of the cancellation request at snapshot time. Values: 'approved', 'rejected'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created (when seller responded).

models.name: ecommerce_mall_refund_request_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable snapshots of refund request state captured when seller approves or rejects, preserving reason and status for audit and dispute resolution.

Each snapshot records the complete state of a refund request at the moment of seller response. This includes the reason text submitted by the customer, the status of the refund request at snapshot time, and the seller's response decision with optional rejection reason. These snapshots cannot be modified or deleted and serve as the authoritative audit trail for all refund request disputes.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_refund_request_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the original refund request this snapshot captures. {@link ecommerce_mall_refund_requests.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who initiated the refund request. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller who responded to the refund request. {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: snapshot_reason
plainFields.description: The reason text submitted by the customer for the refund request at the time of snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: snapshot_status
plainFields.description: The status of the refund request at the time of snapshot creation (e.g., pending, approved, rejected).

plainFields.name: seller_response

plainFields.name: seller_response_reason

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was created, marking when the seller responded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was last updated.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_reviews
models.description: Customer reviews for products with star ratings. Each review links to the customer who wrote it, the product being reviewed, and the order item that verifies the purchase. Soft-deleted reviews are hidden from display but preserved with snapshots for audit trail. Customers can only review products they have purchased and received.

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: ecommerce_mall_review_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable historical snapshots of review edits capturing previous rating and text content for dispute resolution.

Stores point-in-time records of review modifications including the rating value and text content before each edit. These snapshots are created automatically when customers edit their reviews, providing an immutable audit trail for dispute resolution. Each snapshot belongs to exactly one review via foreign key reference. Snapshots cannot be deleted and are retained indefinitely per the platform's data retention policy.

plainFields.name: body

plainFields.name: created_at

models.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_approvals

When a seller submits registration, an approval record is created with pending status. Administrators review and either approve or reject with optional reason. models.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_suspensions
models.description: Immutable audit trail recording seller account suspensions and restorations by administrators. Each record captures the suspension reason, timestamp, and optionally the restoration details. Active suspensions are identified by NULL restored_at, while restored suspensions indicate when and by whom the account was reactivated.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_admin_promotions
models.description: Immutable audit log tracking promotions of administrators to super administrator and demotions to regular administrator by super administrators. This table follows the snapshot principle - records are append-only and cannot be modified or deleted. Each record captures who was affected, who performed the action, what action was taken, and any associated reason.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: The administrator who was promoted or demoted. {@link ecommerce_mall_admins.id}

foreignFields.name: performed_by_super_admin_id
foreignFields.description: The super administrator who performed the promotion or demotion action. {@link ecommerce_mall_super_admins.id}

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: The type of role change action performed. Values: 'promotion' (admin promoted to super admin) or 'demotion' (super admin demoted to regular admin).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Optional reason provided by the super administrator for the promotion or demotion action.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the promotion or demotion action was performed.
